context.family_key: provenance only; cluster both supplied budgets together
context.split: train/calibration/test; TEST cannot fit or calibrate
context.decision_public_state: public feature schema and exact rational feature values
context.budget: initial, spent at decision, remaining at decision and final remaining
context.prefix_binding: source-audit content hash and public gate identity; no future truth

option.name: complete continuation policy identifier
option.reference: complete reference policy from the same prefix
option.trigger_contract: fixed public trigger and full agent+occurrence identity
option.tail_after_interventions: fixed continuation; no repeated learned relabeling

outcome.N: whole FIFO task count through the registered horizon
outcome.T: fixed task-set restricted completion-time sum, rational lower/upper bounds
outcome.queries: actual count, not nominal budget or monetary COST
outcome.reachability: requested/actual interventions and missing public trigger reason

paired_target.priority: task count first; time-space analysis separately restricted to equal-task branches
paired_target.bounds: deterministic numerical enclosures, not statistical confidence intervals

scope: Shared semantic interface only. R13 query C/LD options are not equivalent to third-line graph/search actions, and their numerical labels cannot be transferred without a separately registered common world and continuation contract. IDs, map and error seed are provenance, not model features. Oracle values are diagnostic only.
